sideA.text: They are far from home, in chaos, and hated. They are not sure how much longer they can do this, or whether humanity is worth it. They have found a way to use the satellite towers against the Hollow Men: broadcasting on Hollow Men frequencies leads them astray, which should let the havens move more freely. If Hollow Men get onto the havens, the writers think some of them can be persuaded to join.

sideB.text:
OCTOBER, YEAR 1

Five months on the havens. The writer understands why, but still misses home. They hear stories of a plague on the mainland and ask whether they can leave. They hope the children will soon return to the home they left, and they left a note there to be read on return. For now the children cry every night, but soon it should feel as normal as it can.
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.
